visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair wears a dark green hoodie with a 'Pacific Northwest Woodland Park Zoo' logo. He stands in front of a neutral white background, speaking directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures. (2) A woman in a vibrant pink hooded puffer jacket stands on the white deck of a large cruise ship. The camera uses a wide-angle 360-degree lens to capture the surrounding harbor, snowy mountains, and overcast sky. (3) A close-up shot of the Insta360 X5 camera mounted on a black selfie stick. The device is dark grey with a vertical screen and dual lenses. (4) The man, now in a brown winter jacket, stands on the back of the ship. The wake of the vessel is visible against the dark blue water and distant islands. (5) The man and woman walk down a European-style city street with shops and pedestrians. The camera angle is high, simulating a drone's perspective, looking down at them. (6) Back to the man in the green hoodie indoors; he holds the Insta360 X5 camera and points to its features. (7) A sequence of shots shows the woman feeding reindeer in a snowy field, the interior of a brightly lit ship restaurant with green chairs, and a close-up of the man eating inside. (8) Transition effects show the couple on a dock near a large red and white ship, using 'tiny planet' lens distortions. (9) A night scene shows the couple walking through a lit city street, demonstrating low-light video quality. (10) Screen capture of the Insta360 website showing product details and 'Double 11' promotional banners. (11) The man in the green hoodie holds the camera and points toward a text overlay showing a discount code. (12) The woman in the pink jacket waves at the camera while standing on the ship deck.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem/Solution -> Feature Showcase -> Promotional Offer -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional endorsement for the Insta360 X5 camera. It highlights the camera's ability to capture high-quality, drone-like footage in restricted areas like cruise ships through its 360-degree lens and software features. It emphasizes ease of use, creative editing potential, and night mode, ultimately driving viewers to a seasonal sale with a specific discount code.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product demonstration, verbal recommendation of the brand, and provision of a personal discount code for a specific sale event.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively utilizes 360-degree camera perspective shifts (tiny planet, simulated drone) to demonstrate the product's unique selling point. The fast-paced editing and clear subtitles cater to social media consumption.
